text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Next is one-furlong sprints. Racers, you've
all practiced for this.
Parents, guardians,
friends, and family—make sure to cheer for
these
kids like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wow, amazing! Narita Brian jumped ahead!
She's Biwa Hayahide's
sister, all right.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Brian wins first place!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She's pretty fast out there, just like her big
sister! Give her a round of
applause,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Adult A
text_block_list.text:
She'll make big waves if she ever gets into
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Adult B
text_block_list.text: She might even be faster than her sister.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Brian...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian proved she has more than
what it takes to win the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her final sprint is all anyone can talk
about, and there have been
nonstop
requests for interviews.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The media's clamoring outside the doors
again. Ms. Tazuna was
practically in tears
begging Brian to talk to them.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind making time if it was one
or two people, but Brian
wouldn't get a
minute to train if we let all those reporters
in...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll have to save the day. No worries,
I'll answer all their
questions as Brian's
spokesperson!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, so long as my run isn't
disturbed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Great, that settles it! Fact or fiction, I'll
talk about it all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How about we stick to fact?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't think they'll agree to it, but I
guess it's worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out to train. The media's all
yours.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you're going now, you'd better train
outside the school
grounds. The academy's
teeming with reporters.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Alright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She really only ever has racing on her
mind. However many races she
conquers, it
never seems to be enough.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Her focus is what drives her ability. I'm
sure it'll continue to drive her
past what
we can imagine.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Her focus is what drives her ability. I'm
sure it'll continue to drive her
past what
we can imagine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But just what is the source of all that
focus?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Wait! Hey, waaait!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Sister
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I did it! I win!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Puff... Oooh, why didn't you wait?!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Sister
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it's a race, silly!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! Waaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's this? You're training outside too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So the reporters have been hounding you.
It's no surprise with you on
the brink of
becoming a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And... do you think you can win the Kikuka
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Beats me—haven't given it any thought.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean to say it's meaningless or
anything, but... the Triple
Crown's not my
goal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My focus is on my own path, and on that
path, the third crown is just a
stepping
stone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A perfectly fitting answer for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've always been called a heap of
talent, and now you're living up
to it. I'm
incredibly proud of my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even so, I haven't beaten you yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't give a damn about talent or being
amazing. Those are just
words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All I crave is to finish ahead of you when
we race in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored to be the target of your
ambitions, but I'm afraid I can't
grant your
wish so easily.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I understand that much after trying to
catch up to you all this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I should get back to training. Later, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My word, it's difficult having a sister
overflowing with talent.
Continuing to stay
in front of you is a Herculean task.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I also have my pride as your Big Sis. I
can't lose to you, Triple
Crown champion
or not.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: GOOO! HAYAHIDEEE!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide glides to the front with
ease on the final turn! The
favorite, Biwa
Hayahide, is in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Her pace isn't letting up even in the
stretch! The rest of the pack is
speeding
up, but Hayahide's lead is only growing!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely amazing! Biwa Hayahide claims
victory in the Takarazuka
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Just like her sister, Narita Brian, she wins it with a landslide five-length lead! And in record time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wowie! Hayahide's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! Congrats, Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She really is your sister.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: She really is your sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though they're taking different paths
through the Twinkle Series,
both sisters
are making big waves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If they were to race against each other,
there's no telling who'd come
out on top.
